title: J.D. LaRock:
title_short: J.D. · What AI Can't Do for You
headline: AI can help a student write the plan. It can't stand in front of the judges for them.
story: J.D. LaRock leads a panel on human skills in an AI world. He asks the room to build AI-proof tests of learning, and he starts with NFTE's own: students build a business, then judges question them live.

AI can help a student prepare. It cannot stand in front of the room for them. Thinking on your feet is still very much in play. That is what entrepreneurship education is really about. It must feel confident and hopeful, never afraid of AI.
